ideas.title: The Intersection of Sports and Organized Crime
ideas.description: This story would investigate the connections between sports and organized crime, including the recent cases of sports gambling and drug trafficking.
ideas.angle: The investigative angle would focus on the connections between sports and organized crime, including the role of money laundering and other financial crimes.
questions: What are the connections between sports and organized crime?
How do money laundering and other financial crimes play a role in these connections?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large and complex network of organized crime and corruption in sports. It would require a thorough investigation of financial records and interviews with sources in the sports and law enforcement communities.
